SELECT MAX(((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric) * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END) / 30.0) * (SELECT AVG(CASE v.val WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) FROM jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS v(key, val))) AS max_avs
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID" JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON sd."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS")::int AS yr, AVG("TEMPc") AS avg_temp
  FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore"
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "readTS") BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT y.yr AS year, ROUND(y.avg_temp, 2) AS avg_temperature,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(e."TEMPc" - y.avg_temp) > 0 AND ABS(e."TEMPc" - y.avg_temp) <= 4) AS anomaly_count
FROM yearly y
JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."readTS")::int = y.yr
GROUP BY y.yr, y.avg_temp
ORDER BY y.yr
note: Counts readings (not distinct calendar dates) whose |TEMPc - yearly avg| is in (0,4]; only 2024-2025 have data. Distinct-date count would be 287/46.

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS registry_number, a.art_title AS title, a."MatKind" AS material_type,
  sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' AS sensitivity_level,
  CASE WHEN e."RH" > CASE sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' WHEN 'High' THEN 55 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 60 END THEN 'Over Exposure' ELSE 'Within Limits' END AS exposure_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON sd."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
WHERE sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' IN ('Medium', 'High')
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"
note: 'Secondary, more cautious threshold' not separately defined; used Humidity Exposure Thresholds (High 55, Medium 60).

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS title, ra.risk_level, r."HIST_sign" AS historical_significance, (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int AS cultural_score
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "RiskAssessments" ra ON ra.art_concern = a."ARTregID"
WHERE ra.risk_level IN ('High', 'Medium') AND r."HIST_sign" > 8 AND (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int > 20

SELECT a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty,
  ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric) * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END) / 30.0) AS cpi_score,
  cm.budget_alloc AS budget_allocation, cm.budget_stat AS budget_status
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
JOIN "ConservationAndMaintenance" cm ON cm.monitor_link = l.env_link
WHERE a."DYNASTY" IS NOT NULL
note: 'Generalized budget status' not defined in knowledge; used ConservationAndMaintenance.budget_stat alongside budget_alloc. Limited to the 10 rated artifacts (CPI needs ratings).

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS artifact_name, x.erf AS erf_score,
  (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(c.key || '.' || v.key, v.val) FROM jsonb_each(sd.env_handling_sensitivity) c(key, obj) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.obj) = 'object' THEN c.obj ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) v(key, val) WHERE v.val = 'High') AS high_sensitivities
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON sd."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT AVG(CASE v.val WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) AS erf FROM jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS v(key, val)) x
WHERE x.erf > 4
ORDER BY x.erf DESC
note: JSON summary includes every 'High' rating across all sensitivity groups, keyed group.key.

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS title, a."DYNASTY" AS dynasty, c.cpi AS cpi_score,
  CASE WHEN c.cpi > 7 THEN 'High Priority' WHEN c.cpi > 4 THEN 'Medium Priority' WHEN c.cpi <= 4 THEN 'Low Priority' END AS priority_level
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" r ON r."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ((r."HIST_sign" + (r.rating_profile->>'research_score')::numeric + (r.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::numeric) * (10 - CASE a.conserve_status WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END) / 30.0) AS cpi) c
WHERE a."DYNASTY" IN ('Ming', 'Qing')
ORDER BY c.cpi DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT a."ARTregID" AS artifact_id, a.art_title AS artifact_name, e."TEMPc" AS current_temperature, e."RH" AS current_humidity,
  COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS v(key, val) WHERE v.val = 'High'), 0) AS high_sensitivity_count,
  CASE WHEN (a."ageYears" * (SELECT AVG(CASE v.val WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END) FROM jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS v(key, val)) * power(e."RH" - 50, 2) * e."TEMPc" / 100000.0) > 5
        AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_each_text(sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment') AS v(key, val) WHERE v.val = 'High') >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerated_deterioration
FROM "ArtifactsCore" a
LEFT JOIN "SensitivityData" sd ON sd."ART_link" = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN "ConditionAssessments" ca ON ca.art_exam = a."ARTregID"
LEFT JOIN "LightAndRadiationReadings" l ON l.rad_id = ca.light_link
LEFT JOIN "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e ON e.monitor_code = l.env_link
ORDER BY a."ARTregID"

SELECT DISTINCT e.case_link AS showcase_id
FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e
WHERE e.case_link IS NOT NULL AND (e."tempVar24" > 1 OR e."RHvar" > 3)
ORDER BY e.case_link

SELECT s."caseID"
FROM "Showcases" s
LEFT JOIN (SELECT case_link, AVG(e."tempVar24" + e."RHvar" / 5.0) AS v FROM "EnvironmentalReadingsCore" e GROUP BY case_link) ev ON ev.case_link = s."caseID"
WHERE (10 - ((ev.v + (s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'leak_rate_per_day')::numeric) / 3)) < 5
   OR ((COALESCE(s.case_environment_profile->'physical_state'->>'seal_state' = 'Poor', false))::int
     + (COALESCE(s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'maint_status' = 'Overdue', false))::int
     + (COALESCE(s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'filter_status' = 'Replace Now', false))::int
     + (COALESCE(s.case_environment_profile->'maintenance'->>'silica_status' = 'Replace Now', false))::int) >= 3
ORDER BY s."caseID"
note: SESR averaged per showcase; null maintenance indicators count as not critical.
